meta.title: About us
meta.description: Dadelsteen brings intelligent strength training with imbody to homes and businesses in the Netherlands and Belgium. Read our story and how we work.

hero.title: Strength from the core
hero.intro: We believe getting stronger does not have to be a gym ritual. With intelligent technology, we bring coached strength training to the places where you live and work.

story.label: Our story
story.title: What a date stone taught us
paragraphs: A date stone is small, unassuming and remarkably hard. It carries everything it needs to grow into a palm that withstands desert wind and drought. Strength that comes from within, patient and lasting.
That is how we see training. Not as quick results or heavy iron racks, but as a strong core that carries you for a lifetime: in your back, your posture and your energy.

Dadelsteen is a Dutch company with a single aim: making intelligent strength training accessible to homes and businesses in the Netherlands and Belgium. With personal advice, careful installation and support close by.
story.quote: Getting stronger starts small. At the core.

items.title: Strength as a foundation
items.text: Muscle strength is the foundation of ageing well. That is why strength training is at the heart of what we do, at any age.

items.title: Technology that disappears
items.text: The best technology does not draw attention. It guides, measures and motivates, and simply lets you train.

items.title: Calm at home
items.text: A silent, elegant device that suits your interior, instead of a corner full of equipment.

items.title: Honest advice
